verdict.rationale: Mastra documents built-in "Live evaluations" and "Scorers" for automatically scoring agent output quality (mastra-docs-7, mastra-docs-24), which supports the eval-scoring half of the story, but there is no evidence of documented CI integration, test-runner hooks, or CLI eval commands for automated pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs, CLI command for running evals in a pipeline, independent corroboration of CI usage.
